formulas.ratioToC: role median ms/invocation divided by the C median from the same campaign
formulas.equalFamilyGeomean: exp(mean over families of the within-family mean ln(role/C)))
formulas.positiveLogDeficit: mean or sum of max(0, ln(role/C)); faster cases cannot cancel deficits
formulas.counts: strictly greater than 1.1 and 2.0 over 44 timed workloads
formulas.fixedCatalogBatch: sum(frozen catalog repetitions * observed median ms/invocation); common-work projection, not measured total wall time
formulas.positiveExcess: sum(max(0, role projected workload milliseconds - same-campaign C projected workload milliseconds))
formulas.crossCampaign: (final role/C_final) / (historical old-qbe/C_historical); reduction fraction is 1 minus this ratio

scope: Final native-N2 QBE/x86 prepared-program runtime against same-campaign C. Historical comparisons normalize separately to each campaign C, even though the C artifacts are identical where recorded. These are descriptive cross-campaign comparisons, not paired significance estimates or compiler qualification. No target or compiler execution occurred in this analysis.

broadDeficitComparison.interpretation: The normalized geometric mean improves, but broad C-relative deficits persist: the count above 2x C rises from 22 to 23. Cross-campaign threshold movements are descriptive, not paired significance claims.

regressionArtifactAudit.method: Read-only comparison of retained QBE machine/program.s function bodies. Rename only .Lbb followed by decimal digits consistently within each function, in first-occurrence order. Preserve all instructions, operands, registers, constants, other labels and symbol references. This is normalized assembly-text identity, not linked instruction-byte identity or a claim about executed call paths.
regressionArtifactAudit.commonFinding: All three artifact pairs contain 195 assembly functions, 185 identical after local-label normalization, the same 10 changed support functions, and no added or removed functions. Whole executable bytes and emitted SSA differ. Shared constructor-cache expansion changes surrounding support code; inspected workload-loop bodies remain identical. Source/support-runtime/layout effects and measurement variability remain unresolved; these observations do not dismiss regressions as noise.
regressionArtifactAudit.functionNameConvention: FID decimal character encodings decoded for readability; original backend prefixes preserved.
